_comment: The Open MCP Portal mark, "Keystone" (a round arch of three stones on a dark tile, the teal keystone at the crown), from ../omp-assets/logo/keystone/ (inner SVG markup on the 64 grid). `svg` is mark-small.svg, the drawing for 20 to 47 px, used by components/logo.tsx (28 px, nav bar); `svgRegular` is mark.svg, the drawing for 48 px and up. Written by `npm run logo -- keystone` (scripts/sync-logo.mjs), which also copies the favicons, icons and og-card into public/. If the logo changes, run it again and commit. `placeholder: true` would mean a neutral stand-in drawn by `npm run logo -- --placeholder`.
